status_reason: Trading was suspended since about November 2018 for failure to file audited financial statements; NGX RegCo lifted the suspension on 2026-10-07 after the company filed its outstanding financial statements. The security carries the NGX [DWL] (delisting watch-list) flag on the NGX ticker board, and the 2026 AFS (due 2026-07-29) is still unfiled per the company's 2026-11-02 notice to NGX, so further enforcement action is possible.
